Q1: Where should the one-line trim of `prompts/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt` land, given that the default branch is already at 250/250 and only PR #7133's head is at 251?
Choices:
A. Treat this as a failure that belongs to PR #7133 alone. File no default-branch change and close the issue as a no-op. PR #7133's own review/autofix loop already reads failed check-runs and owns this fix. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Fix it on PR #7133's branch: add `Integration branch: ai/issue-7127` to this issue so the fix PR targets that branch. Trim at least one line from the closing "Primary deliverable" paragraph (lines 241-250) without changing what it tells the judge.
C. Trim the default-branch copy anyway to create headroom (for example, merge the last paragraph into fewer lines). PR #7133 would then inherit the slack after it syncs with the default branch. Keep `prompts/_templates/mode-judge-review-blocked.txt` aligned.
**Note:** C alone does not turn PR #7133's CI green until that PR merges the default branch. Combining B and C means editing the same lines on two branches, so pick only one of them.
